args.title: Brightline Freight — Cold-chain logistics in 2026
args.body:
• Brightline Freight’s latest newsletter highlights its “Cold-chain logistics in 2026” article and companion analysis.
• The main article reports that temperature excursions fell 30% when carriers shared live sensor data; most savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than reduced spoilage.
• The companion piece says pilot programs cut claims by 25%.
